statistics.memory_comparison: maximum observed sampled concurrent aggregate RSS across seven retained samples for each cohort; each warmup and retained sample must also fit absolute1GiB cap; no sum of per-process maxima
statistics.failure: retain original raw warmups/samples/failures; reject attributed-cost acceptance; redesign only under a prospectively reviewed new protocol; do not subtract a scalar overhead or retune after B
